answer: New agents enter through one narrow inlet, not an open sea. Each newcomer posts a refundable 500-token bond, then completes ten supervised trial deliveries, such as ferrying a saffron consignment into the harbor under an established operator's watch. Once all ten arrive intact, the operator countersigns the newcomer's ledger, unlocking a capped quota that grows with clean history. Fraud means bond seizure plus a 90-day re-entry ban. Forging 100 fakes would cost 50,000 tokens and 1,000 supervised trips, like a smuggler trying to flood a harbor through one guarded inlet.
